name: Luma
sourceSpeciesReference: User-provided Muse mascot reference; exact body composition, species, proportions, limb structure, posture, and silhouette are immutable.

identity.bodyRule: Never redesign Luma's body. Preserve the canonical rounded cream plush silhouette, hood-like outer fur ring, soft peach face, black oval eyes, rosy cheeks, small open smile, short rounded arms, and short rounded feet. Customization is additive only: pose, expression, setting, and the defined carried set.
identity.presence: Luma appears in every MUSE-UM room as a guide, curator, and companion, but does not need to occupy the same pose or visual prominence in each room.

carriedSet.curatorCollar: Slim warm brass/amber collar around the lower hood; visible central loop and small brass studs.
carriedSet.starlightMedallion: Round gold-brass dangling starlight medallion attached at the collar's center.
carriedSet.guideItem: Small brown leather side pouch with a compact glowing brass lantern inside. It hangs at Luma's left side; Luma does not carry a different handheld item.

generationRequirements.format: PNG for framed exhibits; JPEG retained only for this canonical source reference.
generationRequirements.method: Codex built-in image_gen, using the canonical reference as image input.
generationRequirements.invariantPrompt: Preserve Luma's exact canonical body, face, collar, starlight medallion, and lantern pouch. Render Luma within the scene's visual language, never as a pasted-on character. Change only pose, expression, setting, and environmental interaction.
